name: Tactical Shooter
tagline: Call-of-Duty-style gun range: animated weapons, iron-sight ADS, recoil, pop-up targets
description: A first-person shooter template built for Call-of-Duty feel. Two fully animated first-person weapons (UZI and CZ Scorpion EVO: equip, idle, walk, sprint, aim, fire, tactical and empty reloads, inspect, fire-mode switch) with exact iron-sight ADS, aim-climbing recoil with partial recovery, camera punch, weapon kick springs, look sway, hip spread, sprint-out, shell ejection, muzzle flash, tracers and surface impacts. The RANGE map is a sunlit desert gun range: five covered shooting booths, lanes with pop-up silhouettes at 10 / 25 / 50 m and swinging steel plates at 75 m, an open-top kill house with pop-up targets in every room, a container yard with sandbag cover and a mantle/slide course, and an armory with an ammo resupply crate. CoD movement (sprint, tactical sprint, slide, mantle), a CoD HUD with compass, minimap, round counter and gun-range stats. Every gameplay system is a readable project script.
